notes: Access: direct fetch worked on every page (robots.txt has only a generic '*' group, no Claude-specific disallow; no WAF/blocking encountered) -> www.bloomingville.com redirects to /en (EN storefront used throughout). No duplicate-company flag for SN173 in the brief. Site is a B2B/wholesale-style DTC catalogue (Danish design brand) with a heavily overlapping, non-tree-shaped taxonomy: a sitewide 'Category' mega-menu (flat, alphabetised) plus per-department pages (Tableware, Kitchen, Accessories, Kids, Outdoor, Lighting) whose sub-URLs interleave (/products/category/*, /products/kitchen/*, /products/home-accessories/*, /products/bath/*, /products/living-room/*, /products/outdoor/*, /products/kids|childrens-room/*). Count method: each real leaf listing is server-rendered with a 'e-productlist' widget exposing data-page-size/data-page-count/data-current-page plus one data-product-id per tile; qty = count of UNIQUE data-product-id values after paginating via ?PageNum=N to data-page-count (Rule 1 exhaustion check: ceil(unique_ids/page_size)==page_count verified true for every row below). Rule 0: ALL mirrors in scope (category/mirrors, childless -> single leaf row). Lighting: product-type-beats-room applied to 'Garden Lamps & Lanterns' (outdoor/lamps-lanterns) - filed under Lighting rather than Outdoor even though it is also reachable from the Outdoor department nav; no other lighting depth found beyond pendant/floor/portable/table/wall/outdoor. EXCLUDED wholesale per brief: entire Christmas department (advent/ornaments/stars/christmas-tableware/bows/paper-decorations/throws-cushions/christmas-candle-holders - all Holiday&Gift), Easter, Room scents/scent-diffusers (fragrance), Artificial Flowers (all faux plant/flower/stem/bouquet nodes), all Furniture nodes (chairs/tables/sofas/benches/shelves/cabinets/stools/daybeds/poufs/racks/bookcases/consoles/sidetables incl. outdoor 'Garden Furniture'), Fabrics/know-your-fabrics (informational, not a listing), textiles (throws/cushions/rugs-doormats/kids textile/towels), bags & cosmetic bags, cutlery/cookware/bar tools (cocktail-accessories, cooking-baking, cuttingboards, kitchen-utensils, kitchen-paper-stands, kitchen storage, placemats, napkins/kitchen/table-setting - confirmed by title-read to be disposable paper napkins, not napkin rings), toys/rocking-toy/soft-toys, for-the-pets, bath fixtures (dispensers-tumblers = soap dispenser + rinse tumbler, confirmed functional by title read, not decorative), category/bed-bath & bath/a-mix-of-this-and-that (title-read: clothes rack/laundry basket/tumbler/soap dispenser/towel/towel rack - all excluded types, and these two URLs are a literal 100%-overlap duplicate of each other). NEVER-EXTRACT marketing/roll-up pages skipped: products/news, products/sale (OUTLET), products/offers/must-haves, products/spot-items, products/essentials, products/my-selections (OFFERS), products/merchandise, brand/series pages, all 'All for the X' bundle tiles, and category/decoration (title-read: a generic catch-all mixing Calendar/paper-Star items with Pedestals/Illustrations/Wall-Decor already captured individually as their own leaves - dropped as a mixed roll-up, ID-overlap-verified as a superset of Wall Decoration 41/41). Also dropped kids/decor ('Decoration for the Children's Room', would-be qty 30): title read showed it mixed 'Birthday Decoration' party items (Holiday&Gift, excluded) with Jars w/Lids already counted under Home Accessories - a mixed roll-up, not padded. Rollup/hub pages excluded from output (not real leaf listings): kitchen/tableware (unstable/huge count, 700+, superset of dinnerware-sets/plates/cups-mugs/glassware/bowls - a 'shop all tableware' bucket), tableware/signature-dinnerware (387, ID-overlap-verified superset of dinnerware-sets 20/20 - a curated 'shop all' collection), tableware/dinnerware and tableware/dining-accessories (both confirmed hub pages with ZERO direct product tiles - they only link onward to the granular kitchen/* leaves already extracted individually, per brief 'file Tableware under Kitchen & Dining'). Facet-recuts dropped after ID-overlap verification (Rule: compare product-ID sets, not names): living-room/votives is a 100% subset of category/candle-holders (53/53) -> dropped, kept the broader Candle Holders and Votives node; category/fans is a 100% subset of category/wall-decoration (7/7, decorative bamboo fan-shaped wall pieces, NOT electric fans - title-read confirmed) -> dropped, folded into Wall Decoration; living-room/hanging-flowerpots is a 100% subset of category/flowerpots (1/1) -> dropped, kept Flowerpots and Planters; kitchen/grinders-mills (salt/pepper mills) is a 100% subset of kitchen/salt-pepper (5/5) -> dropped, kept the broader Salt and Pepper node; kitchen/bowls (173) is a 100% subset of the larger kitchen/serving-bowls (225, page title 'Bowls') -> used serving-bowls as the canonical Bowls leaf. Kept-with-overlap-documented per Rule 0.6 (not exact duplicates, not pure facet recuts): Home Accessories 'Trays' (category/trays, 27) overlaps 21/27 with 'Bowls and Trays' (home-accessories/bowls-trays, 64) but each has unique items not in the other -> both kept; Kitchen 'Trays (Kitchen)' (kitchen/trays, 19) and 'Serving Trays' (kitchen/serving-trays, 5) overlap only 0-1 item with the generic Home-Accessories Trays node -> all three kept as genuinely distinct site-navigable listings. Grinders & mills salt/pepper mills and plain Salt & Pepper shakers, egg cups, teapots, jugs/decanters, butter boxes, serving/table-setting items treated as tableware (Kitchen & Dining) per brief's explicit Tableware/dinnerware inclusion, distinct from excluded cookware/cutlery/bar tools. Jewelry Stands & Boxes (bath dept, decorative trinket boxes) and Jars w/Lids (decorative stoneware/ceramic jars) filed under Home Accessories as decorative accessories. Kids Mobiles (nursery hanging decor) kept in scope as decorative, distinct from toys.
